title: The Vanished Ski Trophy
scene: At 5:15 PM, the silver ski trophy vanished from the lodge lobby. The 5:00 PM cable car takes 25 minutes to reach Summit Peak.

suspects.name: Sylvia Chen
suspects.testimony: I boarded the 5:00 PM cable car and was already snapping photos at Summit Peak by 5:15 PM.
suspects.contradiction: The 5:00 PM cable car doesn't reach Summit Peak until 5:25 PM, and the trophy was in Sylvia's bag.

suspects.name: Greta Holm
suspects.testimony: I folded maps behind the lobby desk from 5:00 to 5:20 PM while the trophy case sat behind me.
suspects.alibiProof: The lobby check-in log shows Greta registering three skiers between 5:00 and 5:20 PM.

suspects.name: Miles Ortiz
suspects.testimony: I waxed skis in the rental shed from 4:55 to 5:20 PM and never stepped into the lobby.
suspects.alibiProof: Two beginners waited with Miles in the rental shed from 4:55 to 5:20 PM.

suspects.name: Roman Kaye
suspects.testimony: I simmered cocoa in the kitchen from 5:00 to 5:25 PM, prepping for the evening rush.
suspects.alibiProof: Two servers tasted Roman's cocoa in the kitchen at 5:10 and 5:20 PM.
